lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: What are you doing, Carol?
lines.translation: 汤姆：卡罗尔，你在干什么？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我在写购物单，汤姆。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: What do we need?
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们都需要什么？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We need a lot of things this week.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：这星期我们需要很多东西。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I must go to the grocer's. We haven't got much tea or coffee, and we haven't got any sugar or jam.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我得去一下食品店。我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱也没有了。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: What about vegetables?
lines.translation: 汤姆：蔬菜呢？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I must go to the greengrocer's. We haven't got many tomatoes, but we've got a lot of potatoes.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。我们的番茄不多了，但土豆还有不少。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I must go to the butcher's, too. We need some meat. We haven't got any meat at all.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我还要到肉店去一下。我们需要些肉。我们一点肉也没有了。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Have we got any beer and wine?
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: No, we haven't. And I'm not going to get any!
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：没有了。不过，我不打算去买！

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: I hope that you've got some money.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我希望你还有钱。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I haven't got much.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：我的钱不多了。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Well, I haven't got much either!
lines.translation: 汤姆：唉，我也不多了！

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Hi, Carol! Where's Tom?
lines.translation: 萨姆：你好，卡罗尔！汤姆在哪儿？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: He's upstairs. He's having a bath.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：他在楼上。他正在洗澡。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Tom!
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：汤姆！

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Yes?
lines.translation: 汤姆：什么事？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Sam's here.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：萨姆来了。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: I'm nearly ready.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我马上就好。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Hello, Sam. Have a cigarette.
lines.translation: 汤姆：你好，萨姆。请抽烟。

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: No, thanks, Tom.
lines.translation: 萨姆：不，谢谢，汤姆。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Have a glass of whisky then.
lines.translation: 汤姆：那么，来杯威士忌吧。

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: OK. Thanks.
lines.translation: 萨姆：好的，谢谢。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Is dinner ready, Carol?
lines.translation: 汤姆：卡罗尔，饭好了吗？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: It's nearly ready. We can have dinner at seven o'clock.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：马上就好。7点钟我们可以吃饭。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Sam and I had lunch together today. We went to a restaurant.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我和萨姆今天一起吃的午饭。我们去了一家饭店。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: What did you have?
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：你们吃什么？

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: We had roast beef and potatoes.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们吃的是烤牛肉和土豆。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Oh!
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：噢！

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: What's the matter, Carol?
lines.translation: 汤姆：怎么了，卡罗尔？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Well, you're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：唉，今晚你们又要吃烤牛肉和土豆了！

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hello, Sam. Come in.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：你好，萨姆。进来吧。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Hi, Sam. We're having lunch. Do you want to have lunch with us?
lines.translation: 汤姆：你好，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭。你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: No, thank you, Tom. I've already had lunch. I had lunch at half past twelve.
lines.translation: 萨姆：不，汤姆，谢谢。我已经吃过午饭了。我在12点半吃的。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Have a cup of coffee then.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：那么喝杯咖啡吧。

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I've just had a cup, thank you. I had one after my lunch.
lines.translation: 萨姆：我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。我是在饭后喝的。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Let's go into the living room, Carol. We can have our coffee there.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。我们可以那里喝咖啡。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Excuse the mess, Sam. This room's very untidy. We're packing our suitcases. We're going to leave tomorrow. Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：屋子很乱，请原谅，萨姆。房间里乱七八糟。我们正在收拾行李箱。明天我们就要走了。我和汤姆准备去度假。

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Aren't you lucky!
lines.translation: 萨姆：你们真幸运！

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
lines.translation: 汤姆：萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I don't know. I've already had my holiday this year.
lines.translation: 萨姆：我不知道。今年我巳度过假了。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Where did you go?
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：你去哪儿了？

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I stayed at home!
lines.translation: 萨姆：我呆在家里了！

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: Is my car ready yet?
lines.translation: 伍德先生：我的汽车修好了吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: I don't know, sir. What's the number of your car?
lines.translation: 服务员：我不知道，先生。您的汽车牌号是多少？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: It's LFZ 312 G.
lines.translation: 伍德先生：是 LFZ312G。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: When did you bring it to us?
lines.translation: 服务员：您什么时候送来的？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: I brought it here three days ago.
lines.translation: 伍德先生：3天前。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Ah yes, I remember now.
lines.translation: 服务员：啊，是的，我现在记起来了。

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: Have your mechanics finished yet?
lines.translation: 伍德先生：你们的机械师修好了吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: No, they're still working on it. Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
lines.translation: 服务员：没有，他们还在修呢。我们到车库去看一下吧。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Isn't that your car?
lines.translation: 服务员：这不是您的车吗？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: Well, it was my car.
lines.translation: 伍德先生：唔，这曾是我的车。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Didn't you have a crash?
lines.translation: 服务员：您不是出车祸了吧？

lines.speaker: MR. WOOD
lines.text: That's right. I drove it into a lamp-post. Can your mechanics repair it?
lines.translation: 伍德先生：是啊。我把汽车撞在路灯柱上了。你们的机械师能修好吗？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Well, they're trying to repair it, sir. But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!
lines.translation: 服务员：啊，他们正设法修呢，先生。不过说实在的，您需要一辆新车了！

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: Good afternoon. I believe that this house is for sale.
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：下午好。我想这房子是要出售的吧！

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: That's right.
lines.translation: 伊恩：是的。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: May I have a look at it, please?
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：我可以看一看吗？

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: Yes, of course. Come in.
lines.translation: 伊恩：可以，当然可以。请进。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: How long have you lived here?
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：您在这里住了多长时间？

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: I've lived here for twenty years.
lines.translation: 伊恩：我在这里已经住了20年了。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: Twenty years! That's a long time.
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：20年！这个时间可不短。

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: Yes, I've been here since 1976.
lines.translation: 伊恩：是啊，从1976年起我就住在这里。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: Then why do you want to sell it?
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：那么，您为什么要卖掉它呢？

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: Because I've just retired. I want to buy a small house in the country.
lines.translation: 伊恩：因为我刚退休。我想在乡下买幢小房子。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: How much does this house cost?
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：这座房子卖多少钱？

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: That's a lot of money!
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：那可真是一笔大钱呢！

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: It's worth every penny of it.
lines.translation: 伊恩：它确确实实值这么多钱。

lines.speaker: NIGEL
lines.text: Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet. My wife must see it first.
lines.translation: 奈杰尔：啊，我喜欢这房子，但我还不能决定。我妻子必须先来看一看。

lines.speaker: IAN
lines.text: Women always have the last word.
lines.translation: 伊恩：女人总是最后说了算的。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: Two return tickets to London, please. What time will the next train leave?
lines.translation: 乔治：买两张到伦敦的往返票。下一班火车什么时候开？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: At nineteen minutes past eight.
lines.translation: 售票员：8点19分。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: Which platform?
lines.translation: 乔治：在哪个站台？

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Platform Two. Over the bridge.
lines.translation: 售票员：2号站台。过天桥。

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text: What time will the next train leave?
lines.translation: 肯：下一班火车什么时候开？

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: At eight nineteen.
lines.translation: 乔治：8点19分。

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text: We've got plenty of time.
lines.translation: 肯：我们的时间还很充裕。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: It's only three minutes to eight.
lines.translation: 乔治：现在才7点57分。

lines.speaker: KEN
lines.text: Let's go and have a drink. There's a bar next door to the station.
lines.translation: 肯：让我们去喝点东西吧，车站旁有一个酒吧。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: We had better go back to the station now, Ken.
lines.translation: 乔治：肯，我们现在最好回到车站去。

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: Tickets, please.
lines.translation: 乘务员：请出示车票。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.
lines.translation: 乔治：我们要乘8点19分的车去伦敦。

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: You've just missed it!
lines.translation: 乘务员：你们刚好错过了那班车。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: What!
lines.translation: 乔治：什么！

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: It's only eight fifteen. I'm sorry, sir.
lines.translation: 乘务员：现在只有8点15分。对不起，先生。

lines.speaker: GEORGE
lines.text: That clock's ten minutes slow. When's the next train?
lines.translation: 乔治：那个钟慢了10分钟。下一班车是什么时候？

lines.speaker: PORTER
lines.text: In five hours' time!
lines.translation: 乘务员：5个小时以后！

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：几天前我把一只手提箱忘在开往伦敦的火车上了。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Can you describe it, sir?
lines.translation: 服务员：先生，您能描述一下它是什么样子的吗？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip. There's a label on the handle with my name and address on it.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：是只蓝色的小箱子，上面有拉链。箱把上有个标签，上面写着我的姓名和住址。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Is this case yours?
lines.translation: 服务员：这箱子是您的吗？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: No, that's not mine.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：不，那不是我的。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: What about this one? This one's got a label.
lines.translation: 服务员：这只是不是？这只箱子有个标签。

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: Let me see it.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：让我看看。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: What's your name and address?
lines.translation: 服务员：您的姓名和住址？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: David Hall, 83, Bridge Street.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：大卫·霍尔，大桥街83号。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: That's right. D. N. Hall, 83, Bridge Street.
lines.translation: 服务员：那就对了。D. N. 霍尔，大桥街83号。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Three pounds fifty pence, please.
lines.translation: 服务员：请付3英镑50便士。

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: Here you are.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：给您。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.translation: 服务员：谢谢您。

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: Hey!
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：嗨！

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: What's the matter?
lines.translation: 服务员：怎么回事？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: This case doesn't belong to me! You've given me the wrong case!
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：这箱子不是我的！您给错了！

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text: Ow!
lines.translation: 安迪：啊哟！

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text: What's the matter, Andy?
lines.translation: 露西：怎么了，安迪？

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text: I slipped and fell downstairs.
lines.translation: 安迪：我滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔下来了。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text: Have you hurt yourself?
lines.translation: 露西：你摔伤了没有？

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text: Yes, I have. I think that I've hurt my back.
lines.translation: 安迪：是啊，摔伤了。我想我把背摔坏了。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text: Try and stand up. Can you stand up? Here. Let me help you.
lines.translation: 露西：试试站起来。你能站起来吗？来，让我帮你。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text: I'm sorry, Lucy. I'm afraid that I can't get up.
lines.translation: 安迪：对不起，露西。恐怕我站不起来。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text: I think that the doctor had better see you. I'll phone Dr. Carter.
lines.translation: 露西：我想最好请医生来给你看一下。我去给卡特医生打电话。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text: The doctor says that he will come at once. I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
lines.translation: 露西：医生说他马上就来。安迪，我看你需要做一次 X 光透视。

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Where's Sandra, Bob? I want her.
lines.translation: 鲍勃，桑德拉在哪儿？我要她。

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Do you want to speak to her?
lines.translation: 您想和她说话吗？

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Yes, I do. I want her to come to my office. Tell her to come at once.
lines.translation: 是的，我想。我要她到办公室来。叫她马上来。

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: Did you want to see me?
lines.translation: 您想见我吗？

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Ah, yes, Sandra. How do you spell 'intelligent'? Can you tell me?
lines.translation: 啊，是的，桑德拉。'intelligent'怎么拼？你能告诉我吗？

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T.
lines.translation: I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T。

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: That's right. You've typed it with only one 'L'. This letter's full of mistakes. I want you to type it again.
lines.translation: 是的。但你只打了一个'L'。这封信错误百出。我要你重打一遍。

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: Yes, I'll do that. I'm sorry about that.
lines.translation: 是的，我会的。对此我很抱歉。

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: And here's a little present for you.
lines.translation: 这儿有一个小礼物给你。

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: What is it?
lines.translation: 是什么？

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: It's a dictionary. I hope it'll help you.
lines.translation: 是一本词典。我希望它能帮到你。

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Do you like this dress, madam?
lines.translation: 夫人，您喜欢这件衣服吗？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I like the colour very much. It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
lines.translation: 我很喜欢这颜色。这是件漂亮的衣服，可是对我来说太小了。

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: What about this one? It's a lovely dress. It's very smart. Short skirts are in fashion now. Would you like to try it?
lines.translation: 这件怎么样？这是件漂亮的衣服，它很时髦。短裙现在正流行。您要试一试吗？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: All right.
lines.translation: 好吧。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well. It's smaller than the blue one.
lines.translation: 恐怕这件绿色的我穿着也太小了。它比那件蓝色的还要小。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I don't like the colour either. It doesn't suit me at all. I think the blue dress is prettier.
lines.translation: 我也不喜欢这种颜色。这颜色我穿着根本不合适。我认为那件蓝色的更漂亮些。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Could you show me another blue dress? I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.
lines.translation: 您能再给我看一件蓝色的吗？我想要一件和那件一样的，但必须是我的尺寸。

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress. This is the largest dress in the shop.
lines.translation: 恐怕没有更大的了。这是店里最大的一件。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Shall I make some coffee, Jane?
lines.translation: 我来煮点咖啡好吗，简？

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That's a good idea, Charlotte.
lines.translation: 这是个好主意，夏洛特。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: It's ready. Do you want any milk?
lines.translation: 咖啡好了，你要放点奶吗？

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Just a little, please.
lines.translation: 请稍加一点。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: What about some sugar? Two teaspoonfuls?
lines.translation: 加些糖怎么样？两茶匙行吗？

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: No, less than that. One and a half teaspoonfuls, please. That's enough for me.
lines.translation: 不，再少一些。请放一勺半。那对我已足够了。

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That was very nice.
lines.translation: 太好了。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Would you like some more?
lines.translation: 你再来点儿吗？

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: Yes, please.
lines.translation: 好的，请再来一点。

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: I'd like a cigarette, too. May I have one?
lines.translation: 我还想抽支烟。可以给我一支吗？

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Of course. I think there are a few in that box.
lines.translation: 当然可以。我想那个盒子里有一些。

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: I'm afraid it's empty.
lines.translation: 恐怕盒子是空的。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: What a pity!
lines.translation: 真遗憾！

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: It doesn't matter.
lines.translation: 没关系。

lines.speaker: Charlotte
lines.text: Have a biscuit instead. Eat more and smoke less!
lines.translation: 那就吃块饼干吧。多吃点儿，少抽点儿！

lines.speaker: Jane
lines.text: That's very good advice!
lines.translation: 这是极好的忠告啊！

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: I like this television very much. How much does it cost?
lines.translation: 我非常喜欢这台电视机。它多少钱？

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: It's the most expensive model in the shop. It costs five hundred pounds.
lines.translation: 这是店里最昂贵的型号。它要500英镑。

lines.speaker: MRS. FRITH
lines.text: That's too expensive for us. We can't afford all that money.
lines.translation: 这对我们来说太贵了。我们出不起那么多钱。

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: This model's less expensive than that one. It's only three hundred pounds. But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.
lines.translation: 这种型号的比那种要便宜些。它只要300英镑。但是，它当然没有价钱高的那种好。

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: I don't like this model. The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.
lines.translation: 我不喜欢这种型号。那种型号价格是贵一些，但它值这么多钱。

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: Can we buy it on installments?
lines.translation: 我们可以用分期付款的方式购买吗？

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: Of course. You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
lines.translation: 当然可以。您可以先付30英镑订金，然后每月14英镑，3年付清。

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: Do you like it, dear?
lines.translation: 你喜欢吗，亲爱的？

lines.speaker: MRS. FRITH
lines.text: I certainly do, but I don't like the price. You always want the best, but we can't afford it. Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
lines.translation: 我当然喜欢，但是我不喜欢这个价钱。你总是要买最好的，可我们买不起。有时候你以为自己是个百万富翁！

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: Millionaires don't buy things on installments!
lines.translation: 百万富翁是不会用分期付款买东西的！

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: Fares, please!
lines.translation: 请买票！

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text: Trafalgar Square, please.
lines.translation: 请买一张到特拉法加广场的票。

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: I'm sorry, sir. I can't change a ten-pound note. Haven't you got any small change?
lines.translation: 对不起，先生。我找不开10英镑的钞票。您没有零钱吗？

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text: I've got no small change, I'm afraid.
lines.translation: 恐怕我没有零钱。

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: I'll ask some of the passengers.
lines.translation: 我来问问其他乘客。

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: Have you any small change, sir?
lines.translation: 先生，您有零钱吗？

lines.speaker: 1ST PASSENGER
lines.text: I'm sorry. I've got none.
lines.translation: 对不起，我没有。

lines.speaker: 2ND PASSENGER
lines.text: I haven't got any either.
lines.translation: 我也没有。

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: Can you change this ten-pound note, madam?
lines.translation: 夫人，您能把这张10英镑的钞票换开吗？

lines.speaker: 3RD PASSENGER
lines.text: I'm afraid I can't.
lines.translation: 恐怕不能。

lines.speaker: 4TH PASSENGER
lines.text: Neither can I.
lines.translation: 我也不能。

lines.speaker: CONDUCTOR
lines.text: I'm very sorry, sir. You must get off the bus. None of our passengers can change this note. They're all millionaires!
lines.translation: 非常抱歉，先生。您必须下车。我们的乘客中没人能换开这张钞票。他们都是百万富翁！

lines.speaker: TWO TRAMPS
lines.text: Except us.
lines.translation: 我们俩除外。

lines.speaker: 1ST TRAMP
lines.text: I've got some small change.
lines.translation: 我有零钱。

lines.speaker: 2ND TRAMP
lines.text: So have I.
lines.translation: 我也有。

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: Isn't there anyone at home?
lines.translation: 家里没有人吗？

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: I'll knock again, Helen. Everything's very quiet. I'm sure there's no one at home.
lines.translation: 海伦，我再敲一次。毫无动静。我肯定家里没有人。

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: But that's impossible. Carol and Tom invited us to lunch. Look through the window.
lines.translation: 但那不可能。卡罗尔和汤姆请我们来吃午饭。透过窗户看看。

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: Can you see anything?
lines.translation: 你能看见什么吗？

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Nothing at all.
lines.translation: 什么也看不见。

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: Let's try the back door.
lines.translation: 咱们到后门试试。

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Look! Everyone's in the garden.
lines.translation: 瞧！大家都在花园里。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hello, Helen. Hello, Jim.
lines.translation: 你好，海伦。你好，吉姆。

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden. It's nice and warm out here.
lines.translation: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。外面暖和又舒适。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Come and have something to drink.
lines.translation: 来喝点什么吧，吉姆。

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Thanks, Carol. May I have a glass of beer, please?
lines.translation: 谢谢你，卡罗尔。请给我一杯啤酒好吗？

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Beer? There's none left. You can have some lemonade.
lines.translation: 啤酒？没有了。你可以喝点柠檬水。

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Lemonade!
lines.translation: 柠檬水！

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Don't believe her, Jim. She's only joking. Have some beer!
lines.translation: 别听她的，吉姆。她只是在开玩笑。喝点啤酒吧！

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
lines.translation: 半小时以前我买了两本很贵的词典，但是我忘了拿走。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Who served you, sir?
lines.translation: 是谁接待您的，先生？

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: The lady who is standing behind the counter.
lines.translation: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Which books did you buy?
lines.translation: 您买的是哪两本书？

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: The books which are on the counter.
lines.translation: 就是柜台上的那两本。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline? He says he's the man who bought these books.
lines.translation: 卡罗琳，半小时以前你接待过这位先生吗？他说他就是买这两本书的人。

lines.speaker: CAROLINE
lines.text: I can't remember. The man who I served was wearing a hat.
lines.translation: 我想不起来了。我接待的那个人戴着一顶帽子。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Have you got a hat, sir?
lines.translation: 先生，您有一顶帽子吗？

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: Yes, I have.
lines.translation: 有。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Would you put it on, please?
lines.translation: 请您戴上，好吗？

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: All right.
lines.translation: 好。

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
lines.translation: 卡罗琳，这就是你接待过的那个人吗？

lines.speaker: CAROLINE
lines.text: Yes. I recognize him now.
lines.translation: 是的。我现在认出他了。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: Look, Scott. This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
lines.translation: 看，斯科特。这是我到澳大利亚旅行时拍的一张照片。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Let me see it, Mike.
lines.translation: 让我看看，迈克。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: This is a good photograph. Who are these people?
lines.translation: 这是一张很好的照片。这些是谁？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: They're people I met during the trip.
lines.translation: 他们是我旅行时认识的人。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's the ship we travelled on.
lines.translation: 这是我们乘的那条船。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: What a beautiful ship!
lines.translation: 多么漂亮的船啊！

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Who's this?
lines.translation: 这是谁？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's the man I told you about. Remember?
lines.translation: 这就是我跟你说的那个人。记得吗？

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Ah yes. The one who offered you a job in Australia.
lines.translation: 啊，记得。就是在澳大利亚给你找工作的那个人。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's right.
lines.translation: 对。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Who's this?
lines.translation: 这是谁？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: Guess!
lines.translation: 你猜！

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: It's not you, is it?
lines.translation: 这不是你，是吗？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's right.
lines.translation: 不，是我。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.
lines.translation: 我在旅行时留了胡子，但我回到家时把它刮掉了。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Why did you shave it off?
lines.translation: 你为什么把它刮掉？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: My wife didn't like it!
lines.translation: 我妻子不喜欢它！

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?
lines.translation: 彼得，你现在能进来喝茶吗？

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Not yet. I must water the garden first.
lines.translation: 还不能。我得先给花园浇水。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Do you have to water it now?
lines.translation: 你一定得现在浇吗？

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: I'm afraid I must. Look at it! It's terribly dry.
lines.translation: 恐怕我得现在浇。你看看，干得厉害。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: What a nuisance!
lines.translation: 真讨厌！

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Last summer it was very dry, too. Don't you remember? I had to water it every day.
lines.translation: 去年夏天也是干得很。你不记得了吗？我不得不每天浇水。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Well, I'll have tea by myself.
lines.translation: 好吧，我一个人喝茶了。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: That was quick! Have you finished already?
lines.translation: 好快啊！你已经浇完了？

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: Yes. Look out of the window.
lines.translation: 是的。你看看窗外。

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: It's raining! That means you don't need to water the garden.
lines.translation: 下雨了！这就是说，你不必给花园浇水了。

lines.speaker: PETER
lines.text: That was a pleasant surprise. It means I can have tea, instead.
lines.translation: 这是意想不到的好事。这意味着我反而可以喝茶了。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.text: Look, Gary! That policeman's waving to you. He wants you to stop.
lines.translation: 瞧，加里！那个警察正朝你挥手呢。他要你停下来。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.text: Where do you think you are? On a race track? You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
lines.translation: 你认为你现在是在哪儿？在赛车道上吗？你刚才一定是以每小时70英里的速度开车。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: I can't have been.
lines.translation: 我不会开得那样快的。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.text: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
lines.translation: 我是以每小时80英里的速度赶上你的。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.text: Didn't you see the speed limit?
lines.translation: 难道你没看见限速牌吗？

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: I'm afraid I didn't, officer. I must have been dreaming.
lines.translation: 恐怕我没有看见，警官。我一定是思想开小差了。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.text: He wasn't dreaming, officer. I was telling him to drive slowly.
lines.translation: 警官，他思想没有开小差。我刚才正告诉他开慢点。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: That's why I didn't see the sign.
lines.translation: 所以我才没看见那牌子。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.text: Let me see your driving licence.
lines.translation: 让我看一看你的驾驶执照。

lines.speaker: POLICEMAN
lines.text: I won't charge you this time. But you'd better not do it again!
lines.translation: 这次我就不罚你款了。但你最好不要开再这样快。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: Thank you. I'll certainly be more careful.
lines.translation: 谢谢您。我以后一定会多加注意。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.text: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
lines.translation: 加里，我刚才叫你开慢点吧。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
lines.translation: 你总是叫我开慢点，亲爱的。

lines.speaker: ANN
lines.text: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
lines.translation: 好啦，下次你最好还是听从我的劝告吧！

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
lines.translation: 您刚拍完一部新电影吗，马什小姐？

lines.speaker: MISS MARSH
lines.text: Yes, I have.
lines.translation: 是的，我刚拍完。

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: Are you going to make another?
lines.translation: 您准备再拍一部吗？

lines.speaker: MISS MARSH
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm going to retire. I feel very tired. I don't want to make another film for a long time.
lines.translation: 不，我不准备拍了。 我准备退休了。 我感觉累得很。 我早就不想再拍片子了。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Let's buy a newspaper, Liz. Listen to this! 'Karen Marsh: Sensational News! By our reporter, Alan Jones. Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today. She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat. She told me she had just made a new film. She said she was not going to make another. She said she was going to retire. She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
lines.translation: 我们买份报纸吧，莉兹。 你听这段： 「卡伦·马什：爆炸性新闻！由本报记者艾伦·琼斯报导。 卡伦·马什今天到达伦敦机场。 她穿着一身蓝色的套装和一件貂皮大衣。 她告诉我她刚拍完一部新片子。 她说不准备再拍电影了。 她说她准备退休。 她告诉记者她感到很疲劳，早就不想再拍电影了。」

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: I wonder why!
lines.translation: 我很想知道为什么。

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
lines.translation: 马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？

lines.speaker: Miss Marsh
lines.text: I may. I can't make up my mind. I will have to ask my future husband. He won't let me make another film.
lines.translation: 有可能。我拿不定主意。我得问问我的未婚夫。他不会让我再拍电影了。

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Your future husband, Miss Marsh?
lines.translation: 您的未婚夫，马什小姐？

lines.speaker: Miss Marsh
lines.text: Yes. Let me introduce him to you. His name is Carlos. We're going to get married next week.
lines.translation: 是的。让我把他介绍给您。他叫卡洛斯。我们打算下星期结婚。

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Look, Liz! Here's another report about Karen Marsh. Listen. Karen Marsh: The latest. At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire. She said she couldn't make up her mind. She said she would have to ask her future husband. She said her future husband would not let her make another film. Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.
lines.translation: 瞧，莉兹！这里又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。听着：卡伦·马什——最新消息。 今天在伦敦的旅馆里，马什小姐告诉记者她可能要退休。她说她拿不定主意。 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。她说她的未婚夫不会再让她拍电影了。 随后她向我们介绍了卡洛斯，并告诉我们他们下星期要结婚。

lines.speaker: Liz
lines.text: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
lines.translation: 这可是轰动的新闻，对吧，凯特？

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: It certainly is. He'll be her sixth husband!
lines.translation: 当然了。他将是她的第六任丈夫！

panels.text: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour. He's a pilot.
panels.translation: 奈杰尔是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。他是个飞行员。
他曾在皇家空军任职。

panels.text: He will fly to New York next month.
panels.translation: 下个月他将飞往纽约。

panels.text: The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
panels.translation: 再下个月他将飞往东京。

panels.text: At the moment, he's in Madrid. He flew to Spain a week ago.
panels.translation: 现在他在马德里。他是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。

panels.text: He'll return to London the week after next.
panels.translation: 再下个星期他将返回伦敦。

panels.text: He's only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
panels.translation: 他只有41岁，但他却去过世界上几乎每一个国家。

panels.text: Nigel is a very lucky man. But his wife isn't very lucky. She usually stays at home!
panels.translation: 奈杰尔是个很幸运的人。但他的妻子运气不好。她总是呆在家里！

panels.text: Do you like stories? I want to tell you a true story. It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
panels.translation: 你喜欢听故事吗？ 我要告诉你一个真实的故事。 这是一年前发生在我的一个朋友身上的故事。

panels.text: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
panels.translation: 当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时， 两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。

panels.text: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room. It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
panels.translation: 他们进到屋里后， 走进了饭厅。 饭厅里很暗， 于是他们打开了手电筒。

panels.text: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them. 'What's up? What's up?' someone called. The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
panels.translation: 突然他们听到身后有声音。 “什么事？什么事？”有人叫着。 小偷扔下了手电筒， 飞快地逃走了。

panels.text: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
panels.translation: 乔治听到了响声， 迅速地下楼。

panels.text: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone. The thieves had already gone.
panels.translation: 他打开灯， 但不见一个人。 小偷逃走了。

panels.text: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there. 'What's up, George?' he called. 'Nothing, Henry,' George said and smiled. 'Go back to sleep.'
panels.translation: 但是乔治的鹦鹉亨利仍在那里。 “什么事，乔治？”它叫着。 “没事，亨利。”乔治笑着说， “接着睡觉吧。”

panels.text: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London. She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.
panels.translation: 上星期米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。她对伦敦不很熟悉，因此迷了路。

panels.text: Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus stop. 'I can ask him the way,' she said to herself.
panels.translation: 突然，她在公共汽车站附近看见一个男人。“我可以向他问路，”她想。

panels.text: 'Excuse me,' she said. 'Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?'
panels.translation: “对不起，”她说，“您能告诉我到国王街怎么走吗？”

panels.text: The man smiled pleasantly. He did not understand English! He spoke German. He was a tourist.
panels.translation: 那人友好地笑了笑。他不懂英语！他讲德语。他是个旅游者。

panels.text: Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrasebook.
panels.translation: 然后他把手伸进衣袋，拿出了一本常用语手册。

panels.text: He opened the book and found a phrase. He read the phrase slowly. 'I am sorry,' he said. 'I do not speak English.'
panels.translation: 他翻开书找到一条短语，慢慢地念着：“很抱歉，”他说，“我不会讲英语。”

panels.text: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
panels.translation: 今天早上我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在了地上。

panels.text: There were coins everywhere. We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
panels.translation: 到处都是硬币。我们找了，但没能全部找到。

panels.text: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
panels.translation: 正当我们吃早饭时，我们的小儿子汤米在地上找到了两枚小硬币。

panels.text: He put them both into his mouth. We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late. Tommy had already swallowed them!
panels.translation: 他把这两枚硬币全放进了嘴里。我们俩都想把硬币拿出来，但太迟了。汤米已经把它们咽下去了！

panels.text: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband phoned me from the office.
panels.translation: 那天上午晚些时候，我正做家务时，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

panels.text: 'How's Tommy?' he asked. 'I don't know,' I answered. 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
panels.translation: “汤米怎么样？”他问。“我不知道，”我回答，“今天上午汤米去了三次厕所了，但我还没看到零钱！”

panels.text: Who served you? / The man standing behind the counter.
